about: Ozi Recipes (6 October 2026): a paid extra. The name, a short description and the ingredients are free to see; the method, read out by Ozi, and adding everything to the basket in one go need the Recipe Pass. Each ingredient's 'item' is the exact name of a catalogue item (packages/api/src/data/seed-data.ts), so it can be added to the basket.

recipes.name: Spaghetti bolognese
recipes.summary: A family favourite, rich and filling.
method: Chop one onion, one carrot and two cloves of garlic.
Fry them gently in a little oil for five minutes, until soft.
Add the mince and cook, stirring, until it is browned all over.
Add both tins of tomatoes and a teaspoon of mixed herbs. Simmer for twenty minutes.
Meanwhile, boil the spaghetti for about ten minutes, then drain it.
Serve the sauce on the spaghetti.

recipes.name: Red lentil soup
recipes.summary: Warming, cheap and very good for you.
method: Chop one onion, two carrots and two cloves of garlic, and soften them in a little oil.
Add two hundred grams of lentils, the tin of tomatoes, a litre of stock made with two cubes, and two bay leaves.
Simmer for twenty five minutes, until the lentils are soft.
Take out the bay leaves. Blend it smooth, or leave it chunky.

recipes.name: Chicken, peas and rice
method: Cut the chicken into pieces and fry them until golden. Set them aside.
Soften a chopped onion and two cloves of garlic in the same pan.
Add two mugs of rice and four mugs of stock. Put the chicken back and cover.
Simmer for fifteen minutes, add two handfuls of peas, and cook five minutes more.

recipes.name: Salmon with potatoes and broccoli
recipes.summary: A healthy dinner, ready in half an hour.
method: Cut two potatoes into chunks and boil them for fifteen minutes.
Put the salmon on a baking tray with a slice of lemon on each, and bake at two hundred degrees for twelve to fifteen minutes.
Boil the broccoli for the last four minutes.
Drain the potatoes, add a little butter, and serve everything together.

recipes.name: Baked potatoes with beans and cheese
recipes.summary: Comfort food that almost cooks itself.
method: Prick two potatoes with a fork and bake them at two hundred degrees for an hour, until soft inside.
Warm the beans in a pan.
Split the potatoes, add a little butter, then the beans and grated cheese on top.

recipes.name: Porridge with banana and honey
recipes.summary: A healthy breakfast in five minutes.
method: Put half a mug of oats and a mug of milk in a pan.
Heat gently for four minutes, stirring, until thick and creamy.
Slice a banana on top and add a spoonful of honey.

recipes.name: Egg fried rice
method: Cook a mug of rice and let it cool a little. Day old rice is even better.
Fry a chopped onion and a clove of garlic in oil for three minutes.
Add the rice and a handful of peas, and stir fry for three minutes.
Push it to one side, scramble two eggs in the space, then stir it all together.

recipes.name: Pancakes with lemon
recipes.summary: A treat for any day of the week.
method: Whisk a hundred grams of flour, two eggs and three hundred millilitres of milk into a smooth batter.
Melt a little butter in a frying pan.
Pour in a thin layer of batter, cook for a minute, then flip it and cook the other side.
Serve with a squeeze of lemon.

recipes.name: Cottage pie
method: Brown the mince with a chopped onion and two chopped carrots.
Add three hundred millilitres of stock and a handful of peas. Simmer for fifteen minutes.
Boil four potatoes, then mash them with butter and a splash of milk.
Put the mince in a dish, spread the mash on top, and bake at two hundred degrees for twenty minutes, until golden.

recipes.name: Yoghurt and fruit pots
recipes.summary: A light, healthy pudding or breakfast.
method: Chop an apple and a banana.
Spoon yoghurt into two glasses or bowls, then add the fruit.
Sprinkle a spoonful of oats on top and drizzle with honey.
